svg.title: Policy-Based Authorization
svg.desc: Policy-Based Authorization. Services ask a central policy engine for allow/deny decisions (RBAC, ABAC, ReBAC). Step 1, Rules scattered in code: Each service hard-codes its own check in its own language, and their approval limits disagree. Step 2, Ask a decision point: The PEP asks the PDP: may Ana approve e-42? Policy plus attributes answer allow, and it's logged. Step 3, RBAC, ABAC or ReBAC: One rule, three models: by role (RBAC), by attributes (ABAC), by relationship (ReBAC). Step 4, Fast, safe, auditable: A local PDP answers in under 1 ms, a list takes one filter query, and if no PDP answers, deny.
